name: What is an in-law suite addition and why should I consider one for my Dallas–Fort Worth home?

mainEntity.name: What is an in-law suite addition and why should I consider one for my Dallas–Fort Worth home?

acceptedAnswer.text: An in-law suite addition, often called a multigenerational living area or accessory dwelling unit (ADU), is a self-contained living space added to an existing home or property. It typically includes a bedroom, bathroom, and often a kitchenette or living area, designed for privacy and independence. Homeowners in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex consider these additions to accommodate aging parents, adult children, or to provide a flexible space for guests, enhancing functionality and long-term value without the need to move.
acceptedAnswer.description: An in-law suite is a self-contained living space added to a home, providing independence for family members or guests and enhancing property value.
